items: [data-engineer] Establish the blast radius: what landed, where, since when, from the real rows and not from the alert's claim. The landed-nothing guard runs first: verify whether anything actually landed before diagnosing, because an incident with zero affected rows closes here

[data-engineer] Write the root cause as a statement of mechanism with evidence, before writing any fix. One incident per run: never batch a second incident into the same dispatch; a second incident is a new dispatch

[data-engineer] Implement the fix for the diagnosed mechanism only, in write-first increments with a recovery checkpoint. A fix that does not map to the written root cause is a new diagnosis, not a tweak

[data-reviewer] Prove the fix on the real data: affected rows repaired or quarantined, the failure mode re-tested to show it is closed, and the guard that would have caught this made to fire. Re-run the original failing case; a green check that never saw red proves nothing

[main] Propose the incident record rows (ISSUES/DEFECTS/lessons per the repo's own homes) with date, evidence and the root cause, appending them via `skill://imp-defect` in the project scope. Root cause is required here, unlike defect filing generally, because the diagnosis was the work. Then run pb-open-pr
